answer: The design leans on commit-reveal schemes for front-running resistance. Each submission hangs on the shale of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a academic prose with citations to prior work register, it stays short.
